entries.aabe71f49c30f0b1: A semiconductor maker that does not design or sell semiconductors but only undertakes their manufacture. It makes large capital investments and operates efficient factories. By contrast, a company that has no factory, concentrates on design and leaves manufacturing to outside parties is called a fabless company.
